result.title: SP-Guide: Enhancing Aerial Vision-Language Navigation with Spatial Priors
result.summary: Aerial vision-language navigation (AVLN) requires a UAV to reach a language-described target from partial egocentric observations while reasoning over large outdoor scenes. Existing approaches typically fuse view-centered RGB observations and globally anchored history maps as generic visual embeddings, leaving cross-modal spatial alignment to be learned from sparse navigation supervision. We present SP-Guide, a transformer- based goal-prediction framework that addresses this weakness of alignment through a Spatial Prior Cross-Modal Encoder, an Instruction Enhanced Decoder, and a Goal Convergence Filter for terminal target refinement. Experiments implemented on the CityNav benchmark show that SP-Guide improves success rate over the representative baselines, with the largest gains on unseen environments. These results indicate that physically grounded spatial priors provide an effective inductive bias for robust AVLN.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SP-Guide，一个基于 transformer 的空中视觉语言导航目标预测框架，用空间先验跨模态编码器、指令增强解码器和目标收敛过滤器在 CityNav 上提升成功率，且未见环境增益最大。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文把物理空间先验作为跨模态几何对齐的归纳偏置，可能与「视觉几何与任务必要信息是否保留在内部状态」这一问题相关，末端目标收敛过滤也可供核查其对停止/终止决策的启示；但整体是导航任务框架，不含显式 latent 推理轨迹，迁移价值需进一步核实。
